header.headline: Tell us what you are evaluating
header.subhead: Form labels are already defined in the application; this page provides the introduction around them. Choose the track that matches your intent so the right team replies.

intro: Sibernetick engagements start with a conversation, not a funnel. Whether you want a technical demo, a scoped pilot, an investor discussion, or a partnership, give us the context and we will route it.

tracks.title: Demo
tracks.body: A working walkthrough of agent orchestration, the approval gate, and sovereign deployment — run by the engineering team.

tracks.title: Pilot
tracks.body: A scoped evaluation in a non-production slice of your environment, with success criteria and evidence recording agreed up front.

tracks.title: Investor
tracks.body: Narrative, architecture, and lab evidence — including the metrics registry with methodology, source, date, and status.

tracks.title: Partner / Press
tracks.body: Commercial agreements, integrations, channel partnerships, and press requests.

expectations: We reply from a named human, typically within two business days.
Technical questions are answered by engineers, not a script.
We will not quote numbers that are not in the metrics registry.
formNote: Form fields (name, email, organisation, track, message) are implemented in the application. Do not duplicate field definitions here.
